reason: Matched03 numeric budgets passed but independent review rejected its isolation: an older cancelled observer app and helpers survived throughout. This prospective block follows a concrete observer/queue cleanup correction and a new process-isolation final gate, rather than repeating unchanged code until a numeric pass.

unchangedBudgetFormulas.cpu: max(baseline p95 * 1.1, baseline p95 + 1 percentage point)

rules.noAgentConcurrentWork: From the first process boundary through the final process boundary, no agent-controlled Electron validation, tests, builds, packaging, gallery generation or simulation. Only the registered five observers, process inventories and short read-only status inspection/documentation are permitted. Record this launch prohibition in the journal; DesMon inventories do not prove absence of generic Node/build jobs.
rules.ambient: Ordinary user applications are uncontrolled and never closed. Any preexisting DesMon or DesMon-fixture helper at a boundary rejects the block without killing that process. No induced memory pressure, forced GC or cache clearing. This guard samples every5seconds and cannot prove absence of processes shorter than that interval.
rules.selection: Exactly one complete prospective block, all five profiles together. No mixing or best-of old/new profiles. Preserve all failures and disclose old/new numeric limits. A failure cannot be followed by repeated unchanged-code blocks until one passes.
rules.failures: Stop on structural observer/process-isolation failure. Otherwise complete all five slots even if candidate budget failure is apparent. Keep every sample; unchanged warmup/duration/budgets. No automatic final acceptance; independent raw/result review required after completion.
rules.sourceFreeze: All game/test/harness/protocol source and packaged apps must remain unchanged from first observation through completion. Source digest, observer/runner/protocol and appASAR hashes are verified at each boundary and final gate.
rules.processEvidence: Record complete parsed process inventories for DesMon main/helpers and DesMon-fixture Crashpad handlers, five-second cadence with <=10second maximum gaps across all slots, zero DesMon at before/after boundaries, exact lifecycle app/userData/PID/start identities, measured Browser PID+creationTime, and cleanup remaining=[]. Nonatomic ps-to-kill identity limitation is disclosed; only owned cleanup sends signals.
